stories.headline: US Treasury chief vows to 'collapse' Iran's regime as Washington sanctions Hezbollah network

key_facts.fact: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Thursday that Washington would 'collapse this regime' in Tehran through coordinated economic isolation, marking a return by a senior US official to regime-change language after months of Trump framing the war as being about Iran's nuclear program
key_facts.excerpt: The United States on Thursday warned allies and China to join President Donald Trump's new campaign to isolate the Iranian economy, vowing that Washington would 'collapse this regime' in Tehran. ... Bessent's comments marked a notable return by a senior US official to talking about regime change in Iran.

key_facts.fact: Asked whether the US would pressure China, Bessent said 'many conversations are best to have in private' but called on Beijing 'to get with the program'; he said he would detail the planned measures at a press conference on Monday
key_facts.excerpt: Asked whether the United States would pressure China, Bessent told CNBC that 'many conversations are best to have in private,' but called on Beijing 'to get with the program.' ... Bessent said he would give more details during a press conference on Monday.

key_facts.fact: Bessent said maximum economic pressure makes a return to heavy military operations less likely: 'If we are doing the maximum economic pressure, then that means that likely there will not be a large-scale kinetic restart, but I will emphasize that is for now'
key_facts.excerpt: But the US treasury boss said the economic plan meant the United States is less likely to have to return to heavy military operations against Iran.

key_facts.fact: The US Treasury on Thursday re-designated Hezbollah as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist and sanctioned 10 individuals accused of running a courier network that moved up to hundreds of millions of dollars in cash on commercial flights between Lebanon, Turkiye, the UAE and Iran
key_facts.excerpt: The US is imposing new sanctions on Hezbollah and re-designating it as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist ... In addition, 10 individuals have been sanctioned for allegedly smuggling large amounts of cash for the military group. 'The network utilises couriers travelling on commercial airline flights between Lebanon, Turkiye, the UAE, and Iran to move up to hundreds of millions of dollars,' the US Treasury said.

key_facts.fact: Iran's Foreign Ministry called the threatened measures 'economic terrorism' and 'crimes against humanity', while Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi called the 'Economic D-Day' a diversion from US debt and surging interest costs
key_facts.excerpt: 'Undoubtedly, the US economic sanctions against Iran, which have targeted the fundamental human rights of every Iranian citizen, are a case of "economic terrorism" and "crimes against humanity",' it said in a statement carried by state media.

key_facts.fact: A new US aircraft carrier strike group led by the USS George Washington arrived in the Middle East on Wednesday as the war approaches its six-month mark
key_facts.excerpt: A new US aircraft carrier strike group arrived in the Middle East on Wednesday, after grim conditions aboard a long-deployed carrier provoked fresh domestic criticism of Trump's war.

stories.headline: Treasury's bond rescue unravels in a day: yields snap back, stocks fall, oil nears $89

key_facts.fact: The 10-year Treasury yield rose as high as 4.71% on Thursday and the 30-year spiked to 5.267%, erasing the declines that followed the Treasury's surprise buyback expansion a day earlier
key_facts.excerpt: The 10-year Treasury bond yield rose as high as 4.71%, its highest level since Tuesday. The 30-year yield spiked to as high as 5.267%, rising just above the level yields were at when the Treasury Department took action Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: Yields jumped again after Bessent appeared on CNBC and teased further bond repurchases plus 'an increased focus on fiscal consolidation' to be announced at the end of this week or the beginning of next
key_facts.excerpt: "We are announcing — probably at the end of this week, beginning of next week — an increased focus on fiscal consolidation," Bessent said on CNBC.

key_facts.fact: US stocks fell as yields rose: the S&P 500 closed down 0.8%, the Nasdaq Composite fell 1% and the Dow dropped 700 points, or 1.3%
key_facts.excerpt: As yields rose following Bessent's interview, stocks fell. The S&P 500 ended the day down 0.8% and the Nasdaq Composite fell 1%. The Dow ended the day lower by 700 points or 1.3%.

key_facts.fact: US crude briefly touched $89 a barrel and closed at $87.83, up 2.3%, while Brent closed at $93.78; the national average gasoline price rose to $4.10 a gallon
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. crude oil briefly touched $89 per barrel, although it closed at $87.83, up 2.3% for the day. International oil benchmark Brent also rose more than 2% and closed at $93.78. ... The national average jumped another 2 cents from Wednesday to $4.10 per gallon.

key_facts.fact: The Treasury disclosed on Wednesday afternoon that outstanding US national debt had topped $40 trillion for the first time, with interest payments on track to surpass Medicare as the government's single largest line item
key_facts.excerpt: On Wednesday afternoon, the Treasury Department also revealed that outstanding national debt had topped $40 trillion for the first time. Interest payments on the national debt are on track to surpass Medicare as the government's single greatest line-item expense.

key_facts.fact: Analysts at Evercore ISI warned that 'increased Treasury activism — if sustained — could also make the dollar less attractive'; the dollar index has fallen nearly 1% since Wednesday morning
key_facts.excerpt: "Increased Treasury activism — if sustained — could also make the dollar less attractive," analysts at Evercore ISI wrote. The dollar index ... has fallen nearly 1% since Wednesday morning.

key_facts.fact: Investors read the unwinding of Wednesday's rally as a sign that the buyback plan is only a short-lived remedy for borrowing costs, with global stocks retreating as oil topped $90
key_facts.excerpt: US bonds unwound all of the gains that followed his plan to increase buy-backs of longer-dated debt, a sign that investors see it as only a short-lived remedy to curb borrowing costs.

stories.headline: US clears $4.5B sale of Boeing KC-46 tankers to Qatar, a mediator in the Iran war

key_facts.fact: The US State Department on Thursday approved a possible $4.5 billion Foreign Military Sale to Qatar covering aerial refueling aircraft and related equipment
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Department of State approved a possible $4.5 billion Foreign Military Sale to Qatar for the purchase of aerial refueling aircraft and related equipment.

key_facts.fact: Qatar requested up to four KC-46As, eight PW4062 turbofan engines, 10 AN/ALR-69A radar warning receivers, 15 Guardian Laser Transmitter Assemblies and eight LAIRCM system processor replacements
key_facts.excerpt: Qatar's government requested to buy up to four KC-46As, eight PW4062 turbofan engines, 10 AN/ALR-69A radar warning receivers, 15 Guardian Laser Transmitter Assemblies for Large Aircraft Infrared Countermeasure systems and 8 LAIRCM system processor replacements, according to a Thursday release.

key_facts.fact: Principal contractors would be Boeing, Pratt & Whitney Military Engines, RTX and Northrop Grumman; the US said the sale reinforces Qatar's 'strategic role in regional security'
key_facts.excerpt: Principal contractors for the envisioned deal include Boeing, Pratt & Whitney Military Engines, RTX Corporation and Northrop Grumman Corporation. ... 'The proposed sale will increase Qatar's capability to meet current and future threats by enhancing its defense capabilities and interoperability with U.S. and allied forces and reinforcing Qatar's strategic role in regional security.'

key_facts.fact: The congressional notification only authorizes the sale — Qatar has not confirmed plans to sign an order
key_facts.excerpt: The notification to Congress means only that the sale is authorized. Qatar has not confirmed plans to sign an order.

key_facts.fact: The approval came the same day Washington pressed allies to join its economic campaign against Iran; Qatar has acted as a mediator in the US-Iran war
key_facts.excerpt: The United States meanwhile on Thursday approved a potential $4.5 billion sale of refueling aircraft to Qatar, which has acted as a mediator in Washington's war with Iran.

stories.headline: Charter closes $34.5B Cox merger, creating a 37-million-customer US broadband giant

key_facts.fact: Charter Communications announced on Thursday that it completed its transaction with Cox Communications and its acquisition of Liberty Broadband, first announced in May 2025
key_facts.excerpt: Charter Communications, Inc. (NASDAQ: CHTR) today announced that it has completed its previously announced transaction with Cox Communications ('Cox') and the acquisition of Liberty Broadband Corporation.

key_facts.fact: Cox Enterprises received about 33.6 million Charter Holdings common units worth roughly $5 billion, $6 billion of convertible preferred units with a 6.875% coupon and about $4 billion in cash, leaving it with roughly 26% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis
key_facts.excerpt: Approximately 33.6 million common units in Charter's existing partnership ... with an implied value of approximately $5 billion ... $6 billion of convertible preferred units of Charter Holdings, with a 6.875% coupon ... And a total of approximately $4 billion in cash. ... Cox Enterprises and its subsidiaries now own approximately 26% of the combined entity's fully diluted shares outstanding.

key_facts.fact: The combined company will serve 37 million customers across 45 states, adding Cox's 6 million subscribers to Charter's 31 million; the deal is valued at roughly $34.5 billion
key_facts.excerpt: Charter was already the largest cable provider in the country with 31 million customers, and after merging with Cox's 6 million customers the new company will serve 37 million across 45 states. Charter acquired the privately-owned Cox with a combination of stock and $4 billion in cash, in a deal valued at roughly $34.5 billion.

key_facts.fact: Within a year the parent company will be renamed Cox Communications while still operating under the Spectrum brand, staying headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut; Chris Winfrey remains CEO
key_facts.excerpt: Within a year following the transaction, the company will change its parent company name to Cox Communications but will continue to operate as Spectrum across all markets. The Company also will remain headquartered in Stamford, CT.

key_facts.fact: The deal cleared its final regulatory hurdle a week earlier when the California Public Utilities Commission approved it; the FCC signed off in February after Charter agreed to onshore Cox's offshore jobs, pay a $20 hourly minimum wage and end DEI initiatives
key_facts.excerpt: The closure came one week after the companies cleared the last legal hurdle, when the California Public Utilities Commission voted to approve the deal ... The Federal Communications Commission officially greenlit the merger in February, after receiving guarantees from Charter that it would commit to onshore all of Cox's offshore jobs back to the U.S. within the next 18 months.

stories.headline: Governments brace for a historic El Niño: Sri Lanka trucks water, Indonesia burns

key_facts.fact: Sri Lanka has arranged water deliveries for nearly 72,000 people across seven districts as a drought linked to this year's El Niño drains reservoirs, a senior official said on Thursday
key_facts.excerpt: Sri Lanka has arranged for water to be delivered to nearly 72,000 people across seven districts as the country tackles a drought linked to this year's powerful El Nino, a senior official said on Thursday.

key_facts.fact: Water levels at hundreds of small tanks in Sri Lanka have dropped to about 10 percent; families will get roughly 75 litres every two to three days, funded by 4.8 billion rupees ($14m) from the budget
key_facts.excerpt: Water levels at hundreds of small tanks in the country have dropped to about 10 percent. Families are expected to receive about 75 litres (20 gallons) of water every two to three days ... The government has allocated 4.8 billion rupees ($14m) from the budget for water distribution.

key_facts.fact: Sri Lanka's environment minister said the government now expects El Niño to peak sooner than the previously forecast November
key_facts.excerpt: Minister of Environment Dammika Patabendi told reporters the government expected El Nino to peak around November but now believed it would peak sooner.

key_facts.fact: Indonesia says wildfires have burned more than 200,000 hectares this year — about three times the area of Jakarta — including 95,000 hectares in July alone, with cloud-seeding teams on standby
key_facts.excerpt: the government says wildfires have burned through more than 200,000 hectares (494,200 acres) since the start of the year, an area around three times the size of the sprawling capital Jakarta. In July alone, fires destroyed 95,000 hectares.

key_facts.fact: Honduras has placed 80 percent of the country, including the capital, on drought alert, and the US says it will send a military hospital to Peru's coast next year to help cope with El Niño effects
key_facts.excerpt: the US says it will send a military hospital to the coast of Peru next year to help the country cope with the effects of El Nino. And in the Central American nation of Honduras, the government has put 80 percent of the country, including the capital, on drought alert.

key_facts.fact: In Colombia, grid operator XM put the odds of a 'very strong' El Niño in October-December at 95%, and the mines and energy ministry said it plans a firm energy auction to shore up supply
key_facts.excerpt: In a special bulletin, the country's power grid operator and wholesale power market coordinator XM said there is a 95% probability that the weather phenomenon will be 'very strong' in October–December. ... The mines and energy ministry said it has been in talks with energy and gas regulator CREG to launch the call.

sources.title: Governments brace for historic El Nino impacts on global weather extremes

stories.headline: Brazil puts R$2.3bn into AI computing, splitting projects between Huawei and US suppliers

key_facts.fact: Brazil's government announced on Thursday about 2.3 billion reais ($444.2 million) to strengthen its AI ecosystem, dividing the projects between US and Chinese companies as it balances relations with both powers
key_facts.excerpt: Brazil will invest about 2.3bn reais ($444.2m) to bolster its artificial intelligence ecosystem, splitting projects between United States and Chinese tech firms in a strategic move that underscores its efforts to balance ties with both superpowers.

key_facts.fact: Just over half — 1.3 billion reais ($251m) — funds a supercomputing infrastructure project in Rio de Janeiro developed with China's Huawei and iFlytek, with the cooperation agreement due to start in July 2027
key_facts.excerpt: Just more than half the total, 1.3bn reais ($251m), will fund a supercomputing infrastructure project in Rio de Janeiro developed in partnership with China's Huawei Technologies and iFlytek ... the cooperation agreement with the Chinese companies is scheduled to start in July 2027.

key_facts.fact: About 1 billion reais will go through a public tender for a supercomputer Brazil expects to rank among the world's 10 most powerful AI machines, to be installed in Rio Grande do Norte for its energy capacity; Lula attended the announcement there on Thursday
key_facts.excerpt: Separately, about 1 billion reais ($193.1m) will be allocated through a tender for a supercomputer that Brazil expects to rank among the world's 10 most powerful AI processing machines. The machine will be installed in the northeastern state of Rio Grande do Norte, chosen for its energy potential. Lula attended an announcement ceremony in the state on Thursday.

key_facts.fact: The tendered machine is specified at 7,200 petaflops and the package also structures a Brazilian sovereign cloud, with data stored on computers in Brazil and software under national control
key_facts.excerpt: O edital para a compra do supercomputador prevê o investimento de R$ 1 bilhão para adquirir o equipamento que fique entre os dez maiores do mundo em capacidade de processamento de IA. A máquina terá capacidade de 7,2 mil petaflops.

key_facts.fact: The Rio center, operating from 2027, is meant to develop a large language model with Portuguese and Spanish skills; the package also includes R$125 million for patent-free chips and training for 3,000 Brazilian professionals
key_facts.excerpt: O centro de pesquisa carioca, com início de operação previsto para 2027, terá a missão de desenvolver um grande modelo de linguagem ... A União destinará cerca de R$ 1 bilhão ao edital de compra do supercomputador, R$ 1,27 bilhão ao longo de quatro anos a um centro de computação avançada no Rio e R$ 125 milhões ao desenvolvimento de chips livres de patente.

key_facts.fact: Funding comes from the National Fund for Scientific and Technological Development (FNDCT) in phased disbursements, with the tendered supercomputer expected to begin operating by the end of next year
key_facts.excerpt: The investments will be funded by the National Fund for Scientific and Technological Development (FNDCT) through phased disbursements. The government expects the supercomputer to begin operating by the end of next year.

stories.headline: Arctos agrees to buy 10% of the Atlanta Falcons at a $10.6 billion valuation

key_facts.fact: Private equity firm Arctos has agreed to buy 10% of the Atlanta Falcons in a deal with an enterprise value of $10.6 billion, according to two people familiar with the matter
key_facts.excerpt: Private equity firm Arctos has agreed to buy 10% of the Atlanta Falcons in a deal with an enterprise value of $10.6 billion, two sources told CNBC.

key_facts.fact: Arctos will purchase the stake in two tranches over the next 18 months, and the NFL is expected to vote on the deal in October
key_facts.excerpt: The deal, according to the two people, will take place over the next 18 months in two tranches with an enterprise value of $10.6 billion. If the deal is approved by the NFL, which is expected to vote on it in October...

key_facts.fact: It would be Arctos' fourth investment in an NFL franchise, after the Los Angeles Chargers, Buffalo Bills and Cleveland Browns
key_facts.excerpt: the Falcons would be Arctos' fourth investment in an NFL team, the others being the Los Angeles Chargers, the Buffalo Bills and the Cleveland Browns.

key_facts.fact: Owner Arthur Blank, Home Depot's co-founder, holds just under 73% of the team he bought in 2002 for $545 million — implying a roughly 19-fold increase in franchise value
key_facts.excerpt: Arthur Blank currently owns just under 73% of the Falcons. ... Blank, the co-founder of Home Depot, purchased the team in 2002 for $545 million.

key_facts.fact: The Falcons failed to make the playoffs for an eighth consecutive year in the 2025 season
key_facts.excerpt: The Falcons in the 2025 season failed to make the playoffs for an eighth consecutive year.
